value.value: Air-stored devices tested under nitrogen: Voc remains stable; Jsc and FF decrease by less than 13%; PCE decreases by less than 24% after the prose-stated 6 days. Figure 7 axis instead spans 0–5 days.

FESEM SU8020; HRTEM JEM-2100; Shimadzu UV–vis–NIR 3600 for QD absorption in toluene and film transmission; Keithley 2636 and xenon AM1.5-filtered simulator under N2 for J–V; Zolix spectrograph with xenon lamp and silicon reference cell OPRC185Si.QG-CAL S/N #1138 for IPCE.

value.value: Authors attribute performance gains to larger CdS/PbS interfacial area, direct transport through ordered CdS rods and shorter carrier diffusion paths. Too few PbS layers leave incomplete coverage; excess overlay may increase recombination. Band energies in Figure 3c are taken from references 24 and 28, not measured here. Proposed follow-up: tune rod crystallinity, spacing/length and contacts.
